summary.text: Lawrence Novak is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 9th Plymouth District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Novak was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.
He lost the 2022 general election to incumbent Democrat Gerry Cassidy and the 2024 general election to Democrat Bridget Plouffe.
